settings.label: Secondary circular DearBody logo
settings.info: Use a transparent PNG. Its silhouette is adapted to the burgundy or cream brand color.

settings.content: Approved DearBody palette: burgundy #5c0006, red #9a1106, orange #d46601, golden tan #e9a250 and cream #f4e3cb. Memphis shapes, borders and shadows use these colors. Helvetica Neue is the fallback until licensed brand webfonts are installed.
Select the existing women’s and men’s collections. If unset, navigation looks for collections titled Women's Perfume / Men's Perfume or For Her / For Him.
